name: Munderkingen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and red, charged above the centre with the city arms of Munderkingen (a red lion on white).
history: The red-white striped flag carries the city arms, which were granted by the Minister of the Interior of Baden-Württemberg on 21 October 1957.

features.role: Munderkingen arms — red lion on white
